title: Two Sum
statement_md:
Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`.

You may assume exactly one valid answer exists, and you may not use the same element twice. Return the indices in ascending order.
constraints_md:
- `2 <= nums.length <= 10^4`
- `-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`
- exactly one valid answer exists
hint_md: What have you already seen? A dictionary answers that in O(1).
hidden_generator_py:
import json, random
random.seed(7)
for _ in range(12):
    n = random.randint(2, 40)
    nums = [random.randint(-500, 500) for _ in range(n)]
    i, j = random.sample(range(n), 2)
    target = nums[i] + nums[j]
    print(json.dumps({'args': {'nums': nums, 'target': target}}))
